inductive Dec (p : Prop) where
  | yes : p → Dec p
  | no : ¬ p → Dec p

def decToBool {p : Prop} [Decidable p] : Dec p → Bool
  | .yes _ => true
  | .no _ => false

infixl:70 " *ᵖ "

def addQ (p q : Rat) : Rat := p + q
def subQ (p q : Rat) : Rat := p - q
def mulQ (p q : Rat) : Rat := p * q
def negQ (p : Rat) : Rat := -p

def zeroQ : Rat := 0
def oneQ : Rat := 1
def halfQ : Rat := 1 / 2

def divQ (p q : Rat) : Rat :=
  if q == 0 then 0 else p / q

def fromNatQ (n : Nat) : Rat := (Int.ofNat n) / 1

def piQ : Rat := 314159 / 100000
def epsilonQ : Rat := 1 / 10000000

def powQ (x : Rat) : Nat → Rat
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => x * powQ x n

def factorial : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => (n + 1) * factorial n

def factorialQ (n : Nat) : Rat := fromNatQ (factorial n)

def leqQ (p q : Rat) : Dec (p ≤ q) :=
  if h : p.num * q.den ≤ q.num * p.den then
    .yes (by rw [Rat.le_def]; exact h)
  else
    .no (fun h => by rw [Rat.le_def] at h; contradiction)

def ltQ (p q : Rat) : Dec (p < q) :=
  if h : p.num * q.den < q.num * p.den then
    .yes (by rw [Rat.lt_def]; exact h)
  else
    .no (fun h => by rw [Rat.lt_def] at h; contradiction)

def absQ (x : Rat) : Rat :=
  match ltQ x 0 with
  | .yes _ => negQ x
  | .no _ => x

def minQ (a b : Rat) : Rat :=
  match leqQ a b with
  | .yes _ => a
  | .no _ => b

def maxQ (a b : Rat) : Rat :=
  match leqQ a b with
  | .yes _ => b
  | .no _ => a

def clipQ (lo hi x : Rat) : Rat := maxQ lo (minQ hi x)

inductive DType where
  | F32
  | F64
  | I32
  | I64
  | U32
  | U64
  | BOOL
deriving Repr, BEq, DecidableEq

inductive Layout where
  | ROW_MAJOR
  | COLUMN_MAJOR
  | STRIDED
deriving Repr, BEq, DecidableEq

inductive Device where
  | CPU
  | GPU
  | TPU
deriving Repr, BEq, DecidableEq

inductive Ownership where
  | OWNED
  | BORROWED
  | VIEW
deriving Repr, BEq, DecidableEq

def dtypeEqDec (d1 d2 : DType) : Dec (d1 = d2) :=
  match d1, d2 with
  | .F32, .F32 => .yes rfl
  | .F32, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .F64, .F64 => .yes rfl
  | .F64, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .I32, .I32 => .yes rfl
  | .I32, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .I64, .I64 => .yes rfl
  | .I64, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .U32, .U32 => .yes rfl
  | .U32, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .U64, .U64 => .yes rfl
  | .U64, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .BOOL, .BOOL => .yes rfl
  | .BOOL, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)

def layoutEqDec (l1 l2 : Layout) : Dec (l1 = l2) :=
  match l1, l2 with
  | .ROW_MAJOR, .ROW_MAJOR => .yes rfl
  | .ROW_MAJOR, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .COLUMN_MAJOR, .COLUMN_MAJOR => .yes rfl
  | .COLUMN_MAJOR, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .STRIDED, .STRIDED => .yes rfl
  | .STRIDED, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)

def deviceEqDec (d1 d2 : Device) : Dec (d1 = d2) :=
  match d1, d2 with
  | .CPU, .CPU => .yes rfl
  | .CPU, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .GPU, .GPU => .yes rfl
  | .GPU, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .TPU, .TPU => .yes rfl
  | .TPU, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)

def ownershipEqDec (o1 o2 : Ownership) : Dec (o1 = o2) :=
  match o1, o2 with
  | .OWNED, .OWNED => .yes rfl
  | .OWNED, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .BORROWED, .BORROWED => .yes rfl
  | .BORROWED, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .VIEW, .VIEW => .yes rfl
  | .VIEW, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)

def NoZero : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => True
  | d :: ds => (1 ≤ d) ∧ NoZero ds

def shapeSize : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 1
  | d :: ds => d * shapeSize ds

theorem shapeSizePositive (shape : List Nat) (nz : NoZero shape) : 1 ≤ shapeSize shape := by
  induction shape with
  | nil => simp [shapeSize, nz]; trivial
  | cons d ds ih =>
    simp [shapeSize]
    cases nz
    apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
    assumption

structure Tensor (Shape : List Nat) (dtype : DType) where
  dataVec : Vector Rat (shapeSize Shape)
  layout : Layout
  device : Device
  ownership : Ownership
  refcount : Nat

def Tensor.shapeConsistency {Shape dtype} (t : Tensor Shape dtype) : Vector.length t.dataVec = shapeSize Shape := by rfl

def Tensor.shapeConsistencyIndexed {Shape dtype} (t : Tensor Shape dtype) (i : Fin (shapeSize Shape)) : i.val < Vector.length t.dataVec := by
  rw [shapeConsistency t]
  apply Fin.isVal

def layoutTransform {Shape dtype} (t : Tensor Shape dtype) (newLayout : Layout) : Tensor Shape dtype :=
  { t with layout := newLayout }

def tensorMap {Shape dtype} (f : Rat → Rat) (t : Tensor Shape dtype) : Tensor Shape dtype :=
  { t with dataVec := Vector.map f t.dataVec }

def tensorZipWith {Shape dtype} (f : Rat → Rat → Rat) (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) : Tensor Shape dtype :=
  { t1 with dataVec := Vector.zipWith f t1.dataVec t2.dataVec }

def tensorFoldr {Shape dtype} (f : Rat → Rat → Rat) (z : Rat) (t : Tensor Shape dtype) : Rat :=
  Vector.foldr f z t.dataVec

theorem lookupReplicate {n : Nat} (i : Fin n) (x : Rat) : Vector.get (Vector.replicate x) i = x := by
  cases n with
  | zero => apply Fin.elim0 i
  | succ n =>
    cases i with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ i' => apply lookupReplicate i' x

theorem zipWithCommVec {n : Nat} (f : Rat → Rat → Rat) (comm : ∀ x y, f x y = f y x) (v1 v2 : Vector Rat n) :
    Vector.zipWith f v1 v2 = Vector.zipWith f v2 v1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    cases v1 with
    | cons x xs =>
      cases v2 with
      | cons y ys =>
        simp [Vector.zipWith, ih, comm]

theorem zipWithAssocVec {n : Nat} (f : Rat → Rat → Rat) (assoc : ∀ a b c, f (f a b) c = f a (f b c))
    (v1 v2 v3 : Vector Rat n) :
    Vector.zipWith f (Vector.zipWith f v1 v2) v3 = Vector.zipWith f v1 (Vector.zipWith f v2 v3) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    cases v1 with
    | cons x xs =>
      cases v2 with
      | cons y ys =>
        cases v3 with
        | cons z zs =>
          simp [Vector.zipWith, ih, assoc]

theorem mapIdVec {n : Nat} (v : Vector Rat n) : Vector.map id v = v := by
  induction v with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp [Vector.map, ih]

theorem mapComposeVec {n : Nat} (f g : Rat → Rat) (v : Vector Rat n) :
    Vector.map (f ∘ g) v = Vector.map f (Vector.map g v) := by
  induction v with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp [Vector.map, ih, Function.comp]

theorem tensorMapId {Shape dtype} (t : Tensor Shape dtype) :
    tensorMap id t = t := by
  apply congrArg (fun v => { t with dataVec := v })
  apply mapIdVec

theorem tensorMapCompose {Shape dtype} (f g : Rat → Rat) (t : Tensor Shape dtype) :
    tensorMap (f ∘ g) t = tensorMap f (tensorMap g t) := by
  apply congrArg (fun v => { t with dataVec := v })
  apply mapComposeVec

def tensorReplicate (Shape : List Nat) (dtype : DType) (v : Rat) : Tensor Shape dtype :=
  ⟨ Vector.replicate v, Layout.ROW_MAJOR, Device.CPU, Ownership.OWNED, 1 ⟩

def tensorZero (Shape : List Nat) (dtype : DType) : Tensor Shape dtype :=
  tensorReplicate Shape dtype zeroQ

def tensorOne (Shape : List Nat) (dtype : DType) : Tensor Shape dtype :=
  tensorReplicate Shape dtype oneQ

def tensorAdd {Shape dtype} : Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype :=
  tensorZipWith addQ

def tensorMul {Shape dtype} : Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype :=
  tensorZipWith mulQ

def tensorScalarMul {Shape dtype} (s : Rat) (t : Tensor Shape dtype) : Tensor Shape dtype :=
  tensorMap (fun x => mulQ s x) t

def tensorSum {Shape dtype} (t : Tensor Shape dtype) : Rat :=
  tensorFoldr addQ zeroQ t

theorem foldrReplicateLeftId {n : Nat} (f : Rat → Rat → Rat) (z x : Rat)
    (leftId : ∀ y, f x y = y) :
    Vector.foldr f z (Vector.replicate x) = z := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp [Vector.foldr, ih]
    apply leftId

theorem plusIdentityL (x : Rat) : zeroQ + x = x := by rfl

theorem tensorSumZero (Shape : List Nat) (dtype : DType) :
    tensorSum (tensorZero Shape dtype) = zeroQ := by
  apply foldrReplicateLeftId addQ zeroQ zeroQ
  intro y
  apply plusIdentityL

inductive ActivationFunction where
  | ReLU
  | Sigmoid
  | Tanh
  | GELU
  | Softmax
  | LeakyReLU : Rat → ActivationFunction
  | ELU : Rat → ActivationFunction
  | Swish

def expSeriesTerms : Nat := 24

partial def rationalExp (x : Rat) : Rat :=
  go expSeriesTerms 0 1 0
where
  go : Nat → Rat → Rat → Nat → Rat
  | 0, acc, term, _ => addQ acc term
  | n + 1, acc, term, k =>
      let acc' := addQ acc term
      let k' := k + 1
      let denom := fromNatQ k'
      let term' := divQ (mulQ term x) denom
      go n acc' term' k'

def sinSeriesTerms : Nat := 18
def cosSeriesTerms : Nat := 18

partial def rationalSin (x : Rat) : Rat :=
  go sinSeriesTerms 0 x 0
where
  x2 : Rat := mulQ x x
  go : Nat → Rat → Rat → Nat → Rat
  | 0, acc, _, _ => acc
  | n + 1, acc, term, k =>
      let acc' := addQ acc term
      let a := 2 * k + 1
      let b := a + 1
      let c := b + 1
      let denom := fromNatQ (b * c)
      let term' := negQ (divQ (mulQ term x2) denom)
      go n acc' term' (k + 1)

partial def rationalCos (x : Rat) : Rat :=
  go cosSeriesTerms 0 1 0
where
  x2 : Rat := mulQ x x
  go : Nat → Rat → Rat → Nat → Rat
  | 0, acc, _, _ => acc
  | n + 1, acc, term, k =>
      let acc' := addQ acc term
      let a := 2 * k
      let b := a + 1
      let denom := fromNatQ (a * b)
      let term' := negQ (divQ (mulQ term x2) denom)
      go n acc' term' (k + 1)

partial def rationalSqrt (x : Rat) : Rat :=
  go 12 1
where
  go : Nat → Rat → Rat
  | 0, guess => guess
  | n + 1, guess =>
      let next := mulQ (addQ guess (divQ x guess)) halfQ
      go n next

def logSeriesTerms : Nat := 24

partial def rationalLog (x : Rat) : Rat :=
  match leqQ x 0 with
  | .yes _ => 0
  | .no _ =>
      let z := divQ (subQ x 1) (addQ x 1)
      let z2 := mulQ z z
      let s := go logSeriesTerms 0 z 0 z2
      mulQ (fromNatQ 2) s
where
  go : Nat → Rat → Rat → Nat → Rat → Rat
  | 0, acc, _, _, _ => acc
  | n + 1, acc, term, k, z2 =>
      let denomNat := 2 * k + 1
      let acc' := addQ acc (divQ term (fromNatQ denomNat))
      let term' := mulQ term z2
      go n acc' term' (k + 1) z2

partial def rationalAcos (x : Rat) : Rat :=
  go 12 0
where
  go : Nat → Rat → Rat
  | 0, θ => θ
  | n + 1, θ =>
      let f := subQ (rationalCos θ) x
      let fp := negQ (rationalSin θ)
      let step := divQ f fp
      let θ' := subQ θ step
      go n θ'

def applyActivation : ActivationFunction → Rat → Rat
  | .ReLU, x => maxQ 0 x
  | .Sigmoid, x =>
      let denom := addQ 1 (rationalExp (negQ x))
      divQ 1 denom
  | .Tanh, x =>
      let ex := rationalExp x
      let enx := rationalExp (negQ x)
      let num := subQ ex enx
      let den := addQ ex enx
      divQ num den
  | .GELU, x =>
      let c := 1702 / 1000
      mulQ x (applyActivation .Sigmoid (mulQ c x))
  | .Softmax, x => x
  | .LeakyReLU α, x =>
      match ltQ x 0 with
      | .yes _ => mulQ α x
      | .no _ => x
  | .ELU α, x =>
      match ltQ x 0 with
      | .yes _ => mulQ α (subQ (rationalExp x) 1)
      | .no _ => x
  | .Swish, x => mulQ x (applyActivation .Sigmoid x)

def tensorSoftmax {sh dtype} (t : Tensor sh dtype) : Tensor sh dtype :=
  let exps := tensorMap rationalExp t
  let s := tensorSum exps
  if decToBool (leqQ s 0) then uniform else normalize s exps
where
  n : Nat := shapeSize sh
  invN : Rat :=
    match n with
    | 0 => 0
    | k + 1 => divQ 1 (fromNatQ (k + 1))
  uniform : Tensor sh dtype := { t with dataVec := Vector.replicate invN }
  normalize (denom : Rat) (t0 : Tensor sh dtype) : Tensor sh dtype :=
    tensorMap (fun e => divQ e denom) t0

def tensorApplyActivation {sh dtype} (f : ActivationFunction) (t : Tensor sh dtype) : Tensor sh dtype :=
  match f with
  | .Softmax => tensorSoftmax t
  | _ => tensorMap (applyActivation f) t

inductive LossFunction where
  | MSE
  | CrossEntropy
  | MAE
  | Huber : Rat → LossFunction

def computeLoss {sh dtype} (lf : LossFunction) (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) : Rat :=
  match lf with
  | .MSE =>
      let diff := Vector.zipWith subQ pred.dataVec target.dataVec
      let squared := Vector.map (fun x => mulQ x x) diff
      let sumsq := Vector.foldr addQ 0 squared
      divQ sumsq (fromNatQ (shapeSize sh))
  | .CrossEntropy =>
      let logp := Vector.map rationalLog pred.dataVec
      let weighted := Vector.zipWith mulQ target.dataVec logp
      let s := Vector.foldr addQ 0 weighted
      negQ s
  | .MAE =>
      let diff := Vector.zipWith subQ pred.dataVec target.dataVec
      let absd := Vector.map absQ diff
      let s := Vector.foldr addQ 0 absd
      divQ s (fromNatQ (shapeSize sh))
  | .Huber δ =>
      let diff := Vector.zipWith subQ pred.dataVec target.dataVec
      let absd := Vector.map absQ diff
      let term := Vector.map (fun a =>
        if decToBool (leqQ a δ) then mulQ halfQ (mulQ a a) else mulQ δ (subQ a (mulQ halfQ δ))
      ) absd
      let s := Vector.foldr addQ 0 term
      divQ s (fromNatQ (shapeSize sh))

inductive OptimizerType where
  | SGD : Rat → OptimizerType
  | Momentum : Rat → Rat → OptimizerType
  | Adam : Rat → Rat → Rat → OptimizerType
  | RMSprop : Rat → Rat → OptimizerType
  | AdaGrad : Rat → OptimizerType

structure OptimizerState (sh : List Nat) where
  velocity : Vector Rat (shapeSize sh)
  m1 : Vector Rat (shapeSize sh)
  m2 : Vector Rat (shapeSize sh)
  t : Nat

def initialOptimizerState (sh : List ℕ) : OptimizerState sh :=
  ⟨ Vector.replicate 0, Vector.replicate 0, Vector.replicate 0, 0 ⟩

def applyOptimizer {sh dtype} (opt : OptimizerType) (state : OptimizerState sh)
    (params : Tensor sh dtype) (grad : Vector Rat (shapeSize sh)) :
    Tensor sh dtype × OptimizerState sh :=
  match opt with
  | .SGD lr =>
      let newv := Vector.zipWith (fun p g => subQ p (mulQ lr g)) params.dataVec grad
      let newp := { params with dataVec := newv }
      (newp, state)
  | .Momentum lr β =>
      let v := state.velocity
      let newV := Vector.zipWith (fun vi gi => addQ (mulQ β vi) (mulQ (subQ 1 β) gi)) v grad
      let newP := Vector.zipWith (fun p vi => subQ p (mulQ lr vi)) params.dataVec newV
      let params' := { params with dataVec := newP }
      let state' := { state with velocity := newV }
      (params', state')
  | .Adam lr β1 β2 =>
      let m := state.m1
      let v := state.m2
      let t0 := state.t
      let t1 := t0 + 1
      let m' := Vector.zipWith (fun mi gi => addQ (mulQ β1 mi) (mulQ (subQ 1 β1) gi)) m grad
      let v' := Vector.zipWith (fun vi gi => addQ (mulQ β2 vi) (mulQ (subQ 1 β2) (mulQ gi gi))) v grad
      let denom1 := subQ 1 (powQ β1 t1)
      let denom2 := subQ 1 (powQ β2 t1)
      let mhat := Vector.map (fun mi => divQ mi denom1) m'
      let vhat := Vector.map (fun vi => divQ vi denom2) v'
      let step := Vector.zipWith (fun mi vi => divQ mi (addQ (rationalSqrt vi) epsilonQ)) mhat vhat
      let newP := Vector.zipWith (fun p s => subQ p (mulQ lr s)) params.dataVec step
      let params' := { params with dataVec := newP }
      let state' := { state with m1 := m', m2 := v', t := t1 }
      (params', state')
  | .RMSprop lr α =>
      let v := state.m2
      let v' := Vector.zipWith (fun vi gi => addQ (mulQ α vi) (mulQ (subQ 1 α) (mulQ gi gi))) v grad
      let step := Vector.zipWith (fun gi vi => divQ gi (addQ (rationalSqrt vi) epsilonQ)) grad v'
      let newP := Vector.zipWith (fun p s => subQ p (mulQ lr s)) params.dataVec step
      let params' := { params with dataVec := newP }
      let state' := { state with m2 := v' }
      (params', state')
  | .AdaGrad lr =>
      let v := state.m2
      let v' := Vector.zipWith (fun vi gi => addQ vi (mulQ gi gi)) v grad
      let step := Vector.zipWith (fun gi vi => divQ gi (addQ (rationalSqrt vi) epsilonQ)) grad v'
      let newP := Vector.zipWith (fun p s => subQ p (mulQ lr s)) params.dataVec step
      let params' := { params with dataVec := newP }
      let state' := { state with m2 := v' }
      (params', state')

inductive InitializationType where
  | Xavier
  | He
  | LeCun
  | Orthogonal

def scaleBySeed (seed : Rat) (i : Fin (shapeSize [1])) : Rat := seed

def initializeWeights (sh : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) (init : InitializationType) (seed : Rat) : Tensor sh dtype :=
  match init with
  | .Xavier =>
      let n := shapeSize sh
      let fan := fromNatQ n
      let vec := Vector.map (fun i => divQ (mulQ (fromNatQ i.val) seed) (addQ fan 1)) (Vector.tabulate id)
      ⟨ vec, Layout.ROW_MAJOR, Device.CPU, Ownership.OWNED, 1 ⟩
  | .He =>
      let n := shapeSize sh
      let fan := fromNatQ n
      let std := rationalSqrt (divQ (fromNatQ 2) (addQ fan 1))
      let vec := Vector.map (fun i => mulQ std (divQ (mulQ (fromNatQ i.val) seed) (addQ fan 1))) (Vector.tabulate id)
      ⟨ vec, Layout.ROW_MAJOR, Device.CPU, Ownership.OWNED, 1 ⟩
  | .LeCun =>
      let n := shapeSize sh
      let fan := fromNatQ n
      let std := rationalSqrt (divQ 1 (addQ fan 1))
      let vec := Vector.map (fun i => mulQ std (divQ (mulQ (fromNatQ i.val) seed) (addQ fan 1))) (Vector.tabulate id)
      ⟨ vec, Layout.ROW_MAJOR, Device.CPU, Ownership.OWNED, 1 ⟩
  | .Orthogonal =>
      tensorReplicate sh dtype seed

inductive RegularizationType where
  | L1 : Rat → RegularizationType
  | L2 : Rat → RegularizationType
  | Dropout : Rat → RegularizationType
  | ElasticNet : Rat → Rat → RegularizationType

def applyRegularization {sh dtype} (reg : RegularizationType) (params : Tensor sh dtype) : Vector Rat (shapeSize sh) :=
  match reg with
  | .L1 lam =>
      Vector.map (fun w => mulQ lam (if decToBool (ltQ w 0) then negQ 1 else 1)) params.dataVec
  | .L2 lam =>
      Vector.map (fun w => mulQ lam w) params.dataVec
  | .Dropout p =>
      Vector.map (fun w => mulQ w (subQ 1 p)) params.dataVec
  | .ElasticNet lam1 lam2 =>
      Vector.zipWith addQ
        (Vector.map (fun w => mulQ lam1 (if decToBool (ltQ w 0) then negQ 1 else 1)) params.dataVec)
        (Vector.map (fun w => mulQ lam2 w) params.dataVec)

def computeRegularizationLoss {sh dtype} (reg : RegularizationType) (params : Tensor sh dtype) : Rat :=
  match reg with
  | .L1 lam => mulQ lam (Vector.foldr addQ 0 (Vector.map absQ params.dataVec))
  | .L2 lam => mulQ lam (Vector.foldr addQ 0 (Vector.map (fun w => mulQ w w) params.dataVec))
  | .Dropout p => mulQ p (Vector.foldr addQ 0 (Vector.map absQ params.dataVec))
  | .ElasticNet lam1 lam2 =>
      addQ (mulQ lam1 (Vector.foldr addQ 0 (Vector.map absQ params.dataVec)))
           (mulQ lam2 (Vector.foldr addQ 0 (Vector.map (fun w => mulQ w w) params.dataVec)))

structure SchedulerType where
  baseLR : Rat
  warmup : Nat
  total : Nat

def applyScheduler (sched : SchedulerType) (epoch : Nat) : Rat :=
  let b := sched.baseLR
  let w := sched.warmup
  let t := sched.total
  if decToBool (Nat.decLt epoch w) then
    mulQ b (divQ (fromNatQ (epoch + 1)) (fromNatQ (w + 1)))
  else
    let e := epoch + 1
    let prog := divQ (fromNatQ e) (fromNatQ (t + 1))
    let c := rationalCos (mulQ prog piQ)
    mulQ b (mulQ halfQ (addQ 1 c))

def clipGradientByValue {n : Nat} (clip : Rat) (v : Vector Rat n) : Vector Rat n :=
  Vector.map (fun g => clipQ (negQ clip) clip g) v

def clipGradientByNorm {n : Nat} (clip : Rat) (v : Vector Rat n) : Vector Rat n :=
  let sq := Vector.map (fun g => mulQ g g) v
  let s := Vector.foldr addQ 0 sq
  let norm := rationalSqrt s
  if decToBool (leqQ norm clip) then v
  else Vector.map (fun g => mulQ g (divQ clip norm)) v

theorem absoluteFinalVerification : True := trivial

end TensorCompleteExpanded

def addQ (p q : Rat) : Rat := p + q
def subQ (p q : Rat) : Rat := p - q
def mulQ (p q : Rat) : Rat := p * q
def negQ (p : Rat) : Rat := -p

def zeroQ : Rat := 0
def oneQ : Rat := 1
def halfQ : Rat := 1 / 2

def divQ (p q : Rat) : Rat :=
  if q == 0 then 0 else p / q

def fromNatQ (n : Nat) : Rat := (Int.ofNat n) / 1

def piQ : Rat := 314159 / 100000
def epsilonQ : Rat := 1 / 10000000

def powQ (x : Rat) : Nat → Rat
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => x * powQ x n

def factorial : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => (n + 1) * factorial n

def factorialQ (n : Nat) : Rat := fromNatQ (factorial n)

def leqQ (p q : Rat) : Dec (p ≤ q) :=
  if h : p.num * q.den ≤ q.num * p.den then
    .yes (by rw [Rat.le_def]; exact h)
  else
    .no (fun h => by rw [Rat.le_def] at h; contradiction)

def ltQ (p q : Rat) : Dec (p < q) :=
  if h : p.num * q.den < q.num * p.den then
    .yes (by rw [Rat.lt_def]; exact h)
  else
    .no (fun h => by rw [Rat.lt_def] at h; contradiction)

def absQ (x : Rat) : Rat :=
  match ltQ x 0 with
  | .yes _ => negQ x
  | .no _ => x

def minQ (a b : Rat) : Rat :=
  match leqQ a b with
  | .yes _ => a
  | .no _ => b

def maxQ (a b : Rat) : Rat :=
  match leqQ a b with
  | .yes _ => b
  | .no _ => a

def clipQ (lo hi x : Rat) : Rat := maxQ lo (minQ hi x)

inductive DType where
  | F32
  | F64
  | I32
  | I64
  | U32
  | U64
  | BOOL
deriving Repr, BEq, DecidableEq

inductive Layout where
  | ROW_MAJOR
  | COLUMN_MAJOR
  | STRIDED
deriving Repr, BEq, DecidableEq

inductive Device where
  | CPU
  | GPU
  | TPU
deriving Repr, BEq, DecidableEq

inductive Ownership where
  | OWNED
  | BORROWED
  | VIEW
deriving Repr, BEq, DecidableEq

def dtypeEqDec (d1 d2 : DType) : Dec (d1 = d2) :=
  match d1, d2 with
  | .F32, .F32 => .yes rfl
  | .F32, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .F64, .F64 => .yes rfl
  | .F64, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .I32, .I32 => .yes rfl
  | .I32, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .I64, .I64 => .yes rfl
  | .I64, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .U32, .U32 => .yes rfl
  | .U32, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .U64, .U64 => .yes rfl
  | .U64, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .BOOL, .BOOL => .yes rfl
  | .BOOL, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)

def layoutEqDec (l1 l2 : Layout) : Dec (l1 = l2) :=
  match l1, l2 with
  | .ROW_MAJOR, .ROW_MAJOR => .yes rfl
  | .ROW_MAJOR, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .COLUMN_MAJOR, .COLUMN_MAJOR => .yes rfl
  | .COLUMN_MAJOR, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .STRIDED, .STRIDED => .yes rfl
  | .STRIDED, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)

def deviceEqDec (d1 d2 : Device) : Dec (d1 = d2) :=
  match d1, d2 with
  | .CPU, .CPU => .yes rfl
  | .CPU, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .GPU, .GPU => .yes rfl
  | .GPU, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .TPU, .TPU => .yes rfl
  | .TPU, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)

def ownershipEqDec (o1 o2 : Ownership) : Dec (o1 = o2) :=
  match o1, o2 with
  | .OWNED, .OWNED => .yes rfl
  | .OWNED, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .BORROWED, .BORROWED => .yes rfl
  | .BORROWED, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)
  | .VIEW, .VIEW => .yes rfl
  | .VIEW, _ => .no (by intros h; cases h)

def NoZero : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => True
  | d :: ds => (1 ≤ d) ∧ NoZero ds

def shapeSize : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 1
  | d :: ds => d * shapeSize ds

theorem shapeSizePositive (shape : List Nat) (nz : NoZero shape) : 1 ≤ shapeSize shape := by
  induction shape with
  | nil => simp [shapeSize, nz]; trivial
  | cons d ds ih =>
    simp [shapeSize]
    cases nz
    apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
    assumption

structure Tensor (Shape : List Nat) (dtype : DType) where
  dataVec : Vector Rat (shapeSize Shape)
  layout : Layout
  device : Device
  ownership : Ownership
  refcount : Nat

def Tensor.shapeConsistency {Shape dtype} (t : Tensor Shape dtype) : Vector.length t.dataVec = shapeSize Shape := by rfl

def Tensor.shapeConsistencyIndexed {Shape dtype} (t : Tensor Shape dtype) (i : Fin (shapeSize Shape)) : i.val < Vector.length t.dataVec := by
  rw [shapeConsistency t]
  apply Fin.isVal

def layoutTransform {Shape dtype} (t : Tensor Shape dtype) (newLayout : Layout) : Tensor Shape dtype :=
  { t with layout := newLayout }

def tensorMap {Shape dtype} (f : Rat → Rat) (t : Tensor Shape dtype) : Tensor Shape dtype :=
  { t with dataVec := Vector.map f t.dataVec }

def tensorZipWith {Shape dtype} (f : Rat → Rat → Rat) (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) : Tensor Shape dtype :=
  { t1 with dataVec := Vector.zipWith f t1.dataVec t2.dataVec }

def tensorFoldr {Shape dtype} (f : Rat → Rat → Rat) (z : Rat) (t : Tensor Shape dtype) : Rat :=
  Vector.foldr f z t.dataVec

theorem lookupReplicate {n : Nat} (i : Fin n) (x : Rat) : Vector.get (Vector.replicate x) i = x := by
  cases n with
  | zero => apply Fin.elim0 i
  | succ n =>
    cases i with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ i' => apply lookupReplicate i' x

theorem zipWithCommVec {n : Nat} (f : Rat → Rat → Rat) (comm : ∀ x y, f x y = f y x) (v1 v2 : Vector Rat n) :
    Vector.zipWith f v1 v2 = Vector.zipWith f v2 v1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    cases v1 with
    | cons x xs =>
      cases v2 with
      | cons y ys =>
        simp [Vector.zipWith, ih, comm]

theorem zipWithAssocVec {n : Nat} (f : Rat → Rat → Rat) (assoc : ∀ a b c, f (f a b) c = f a (f b c))
    (v1 v2 v3 : Vector Rat n) :
    Vector.zipWith f (Vector.zipWith f v1 v2) v3 = Vector.zipWith f v1 (Vector.zipWith f v2 v3) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    cases v1 with
    | cons x xs =>
      cases v2 with
      | cons y ys =>
        cases v3 with
        | cons z zs =>
          simp [Vector.zipWith, ih, assoc]

theorem mapIdVec {n : Nat} (v : Vector Rat n) : Vector.map id v = v := by
  induction v with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp [Vector.map, ih]

theorem mapComposeVec {n : Nat} (f g : Rat → Rat) (v : Vector Rat n) :
    Vector.map (f ∘ g) v = Vector.map f (Vector.map g v) := by
  induction v with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp [Vector.map, ih, Function.comp]

theorem tensorMapId {Shape dtype} (t : Tensor Shape dtype) :
    tensorMap id t = t := by
  apply congrArg (fun v => { t with dataVec := v })
  apply mapIdVec

theorem tensorMapCompose {Shape dtype} (f g : Rat → Rat) (t : Tensor Shape dtype) :
    tensorMap (f ∘ g) t = tensorMap f (tensorMap g t) := by
  apply congrArg (fun v => { t with dataVec := v })
  apply mapComposeVec

def tensorReplicate (Shape : List Nat) (dtype : DType) (v : Rat) : Tensor Shape dtype :=
  ⟨ Vector.replicate v, Layout.ROW_MAJOR, Device.CPU, Ownership.OWNED, 1 ⟩

def tensorZero (Shape : List Nat) (dtype : DType) : Tensor Shape dtype :=
  tensorReplicate Shape dtype zeroQ

def tensorOne (Shape : List Nat) (dtype : DType) : Tensor Shape dtype :=
  tensorReplicate Shape dtype oneQ

def tensorAdd {Shape dtype} : Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype :=
  tensorZipWith addQ

def tensorMul {Shape dtype} : Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype → Tensor Shape dtype :=
  tensorZipWith mulQ

def tensorScalarMul {Shape dtype} (s : Rat) (t : Tensor Shape dtype) : Tensor Shape dtype :=
  tensorMap (fun x => mulQ s x) t

def tensorSum {Shape dtype} (t : Tensor Shape dtype) : Rat :=
  tensorFoldr addQ zeroQ t

theorem foldrReplicateLeftId {n : Nat} (f : Rat → Rat → Rat) (z x : Rat)
    (leftId : ∀ y, f x y = y) :
    Vector.foldr f z (Vector.replicate x) = z := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp [Vector.foldr, ih]
    apply leftId

theorem plusIdentityL (x : Rat) : zeroQ + x = x := by rfl

theorem tensorSumZero (Shape : List Nat) (dtype : DType) :
    tensorSum (tensorZero Shape dtype) = zeroQ := by
  apply foldrReplicateLeftId addQ zeroQ zeroQ
  intro y
  apply plusIdentityL

inductive ActivationFunction where
  | ReLU
  | Sigmoid
  | Tanh
  | GELU
  | Softmax
  | LeakyReLU : Rat → ActivationFunction
  | ELU : Rat → ActivationFunction
  | Swish

def expSeriesTerms : Nat := 24

partial def rationalExp (x : Rat) : Rat :=
  go expSeriesTerms 0 1 0
where
  go : Nat → Rat → Rat → Nat → Rat
  | 0, acc, term, _ => addQ acc term
  | n + 1, acc, term, k =>
      let acc' := addQ acc term
      let k' := k + 1
      let denom := fromNatQ k'
      let term' := divQ (mulQ term x) denom
      go n acc' term' k'

def sinSeriesTerms : Nat := 18
def cosSeriesTerms : Nat := 18

partial def rationalSin (x : Rat) : Rat :=
  go sinSeriesTerms 0 x 0
where
  x2 : Rat := mulQ x x
  go : Nat → Rat → Rat → Nat → Rat
  | 0, acc, _, _ => acc
  | n + 1, acc, term, k =>
      let acc' := addQ acc term
      let a := 2 * k + 1
      let b := a + 1
      let c := b + 1
      let denom := fromNatQ (b * c)
      let term' := negQ (divQ (mulQ term x2) denom)
      go n acc' term' (k + 1)

partial def rationalCos (x : Rat) : Rat :=
  go cosSeriesTerms 0 1 0
where
  x2 : Rat := mulQ x x
  go : Nat → Rat → Rat → Nat → Rat
  | 0, acc, _, _ => acc
  | n + 1, acc, term, k =>
      let acc' := addQ acc term
      let a := 2 * k
      let b := a + 1
      let denom := fromNatQ (a * b)
      let term' := negQ (divQ (mulQ term x2) denom)
      go n acc' term' (k + 1)

partial def rationalSqrt (x : Rat) : Rat :=
  go 12 1
where
  go : Nat → Rat → Rat
  | 0, guess => guess
  | n + 1, guess =>
      let next := mulQ (addQ guess (divQ x guess)) halfQ
      go n next

def logSeriesTerms : Nat := 24

partial def rationalLog (x : Rat) : Rat :=
  match leqQ x 0 with
  | .yes _ => 0
  | .no _ =>
      let z := divQ (subQ x 1) (addQ x 1)
      let z2 := mulQ z z
      let s := go logSeriesTerms 0 z 0 z2
      mulQ (fromNatQ 2) s
where
  go : Nat → Rat → Rat → Nat → Rat → Rat
  | 0, acc, _, _, _ => acc
  | n + 1, acc, term, k, z2 =>
      let denomNat := 2 * k + 1
      let acc' := addQ acc (divQ term (fromNatQ denomNat))
      let term' := mulQ term z2
      go n acc' term' (k + 1) z2

partial def rationalAcos (x : Rat) : Rat :=
  go 12 0
where
  go : Nat → Rat → Rat
  | 0, θ => θ
  | n + 1, θ =>
      let f := subQ (rationalCos θ) x
      let fp := negQ (rationalSin θ)
      let step := divQ f fp
      let θ' := subQ θ step
      go n θ'

def applyActivation : ActivationFunction → Rat → Rat
  | .ReLU, x => maxQ 0 x
  | .Sigmoid, x =>
      let denom := addQ 1 (rationalExp (negQ x))
      divQ 1 denom
  | .Tanh, x =>
      let ex := rationalExp x
      let enx := rationalExp (negQ x)
      let num := subQ ex enx
      let den := addQ ex enx
      divQ num den
  | .GELU, x =>
      let c := 1702 / 1000
      mulQ x (applyActivation .Sigmoid (mulQ c x))
  | .Softmax, x => x
  | .LeakyReLU α, x =>
      match ltQ x 0 with
      | .yes _ => mulQ α x
      | .no _ => x
  | .ELU α, x =>
      match ltQ x 0 with
      | .yes _ => mulQ α (subQ (rationalExp x) 1)
      | .no _ => x
  | .Swish, x => mulQ x (applyActivation .Sigmoid x)

def tensorSoftmax {sh dtype} (t : Tensor sh dtype) : Tensor sh dtype :=
  let exps := tensorMap rationalExp t
  let s := tensorSum exps
  if decToBool (leqQ s 0) then uniform else normalize s exps
where
  n : Nat := shapeSize sh
  invN : Rat :=
    match n with
    | 0 => 0
    | k + 1 => divQ 1 (fromNatQ (k + 1))
  uniform : Tensor sh dtype := { t with dataVec := Vector.replicate invN }
  normalize (denom : Rat) (t0 : Tensor sh dtype) : Tensor sh dtype :=
    tensorMap (fun e => divQ e denom) t0

def tensorApplyActivation {sh dtype} (f : ActivationFunction) (t : Tensor sh dtype) : Tensor sh dtype :=
  match f with
  | .Softmax => tensorSoftmax t
  | _ => tensorMap (applyActivation f) t

inductive LossFunction where
  | MSE
  | CrossEntropy
  | MAE
  | Huber : Rat → LossFunction

def computeLoss {sh dtype} (lf : LossFunction) (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) : Rat :=
  match lf with
  | .MSE =>
      let diff := Vector.zipWith subQ pred.dataVec target.dataVec
      let squared := Vector.map (fun x => mulQ x x) diff
      let sumsq := Vector.foldr addQ 0 squared
      divQ sumsq (fromNatQ (shapeSize sh))
  | .CrossEntropy =>
      let logp := Vector.map rationalLog pred.dataVec
      let weighted := Vector.zipWith mulQ target.dataVec logp
      let s := Vector.foldr addQ 0 weighted
      negQ s
  | .MAE =>
      let diff := Vector.zipWith subQ pred.dataVec target.dataVec
      let absd := Vector.map absQ diff
      let s := Vector.foldr addQ 0 absd
      divQ s (fromNatQ (shapeSize sh))
  | .Huber δ =>
      let diff := Vector.zipWith subQ pred.dataVec target.dataVec
      let absd := Vector.map absQ diff
      let term := Vector.map (fun a =>
        if decToBool (leqQ a δ) then mulQ halfQ (mulQ a a) else mulQ δ (subQ a (mulQ halfQ δ))
      ) absd
      let s := Vector.foldr addQ 0 term
      divQ s (fromNatQ (shapeSize sh))

inductive OptimizerType where
  | SGD : Rat → OptimizerType
  | Momentum : Rat → Rat → OptimizerType
  | Adam : Rat → Rat → Rat → OptimizerType
  | RMSprop : Rat → Rat → OptimizerType
  | AdaGrad : Rat → OptimizerType

structure OptimizerState (sh : List Nat) where
  velocity : Vector Rat (shapeSize sh)
  m1 : Vector Rat (shapeSize sh)
  m2 : Vector Rat (shapeSize sh)
  t : Nat

def initialOptimizerState (sh : List ℕ) : OptimizerState sh :=
  ⟨ Vector.replicate 0, Vector.replicate 0, Vector.replicate 0, 0 ⟩

def applyOptimizer {sh dtype} (opt : OptimizerType) (state : OptimizerState sh)
    (params : Tensor sh dtype) (grad : Vector Rat (shapeSize sh)) :
    Tensor sh dtype × OptimizerState sh :=
  match opt with
  | .SGD lr =>
      let newv := Vector.zipWith (fun p g => subQ p (mulQ lr g)) params.dataVec grad
      let newp := { params with dataVec := newv }
      (newp, state)
  | .Momentum lr β =>
      let v := state.velocity
      let newV := Vector.zipWith (fun vi gi => addQ (mulQ β vi) (mulQ (subQ 1 β) gi)) v grad
      let newP := Vector.zipWith (fun p vi => subQ p (mulQ lr vi)) params.dataVec newV
      let params' := { params with dataVec := newP }
      let state' := { state with velocity := newV }
      (params', state')
  | .Adam lr β1 β2 =>
      let m := state.m1
      let v := state.m2
      let t0 := state.t
      let t1 := t0 + 1
      let m' := Vector.zipWith (fun mi gi => addQ (mulQ β1 mi) (mulQ (subQ 1 β1) gi)) m grad
      let v' := Vector.zipWith (fun vi gi => addQ (mulQ β2 vi) (mulQ (subQ 1 β2) (mulQ gi gi))) v grad
      let denom1 := subQ 1 (powQ β1 t1)
      let denom2 := subQ 1 (powQ β2 t1)
      let mhat := Vector.map (fun mi => divQ mi denom1) m'
      let vhat := Vector.map (fun vi => divQ vi denom2) v'
      let step := Vector.zipWith (fun mi vi => divQ mi (addQ (rationalSqrt vi) epsilonQ)) mhat vhat
      let newP := Vector.zipWith (fun p s => subQ p (mulQ lr s)) params.dataVec step
      let params' := { params with dataVec := newP }
      let state' := { state with m1 := m', m2 := v', t := t1 }
      (params', state')
  | .RMSprop lr α =>
      let v := state.m2
      let v' := Vector.zipWith (fun vi gi => addQ (mulQ α vi) (mulQ (subQ 1 α) (mulQ gi gi))) v grad
      let step := Vector.zipWith (fun gi vi => divQ gi (addQ (rationalSqrt vi) epsilonQ)) grad v'
      let newP := Vector.zipWith (fun p s => subQ p (mulQ lr s)) params.dataVec step
      let params' := { params with dataVec := newP }
      let state' := { state with m2 := v' }
      (params', state')
  | .AdaGrad lr =>
      let v := state.m2
      let v' := Vector.zipWith (fun vi gi => addQ vi (mulQ gi gi)) v grad
      let step := Vector.zipWith (fun gi vi => divQ gi (addQ (rationalSqrt vi) epsilonQ)) grad v'
      let newP := Vector.zipWith (fun p s => subQ p (mulQ lr s)) params.dataVec step
      let params' := { params with dataVec := newP }
      let state' := { state with m2 := v' }
      (params', state')

inductive InitializationType where
  | Xavier
  | He
  | LeCun
  | Orthogonal

def scaleBySeed (seed : Rat) (i : Fin (shapeSize [1])) : Rat := seed

def initializeWeights (sh : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) (init : InitializationType) (seed : Rat) : Tensor sh dtype :=
  match init with
  | .Xavier =>
      let n := shapeSize sh
      let fan := fromNatQ n
      let vec := Vector.map (fun i => divQ (mulQ (fromNatQ i.val) seed) (addQ fan 1)) (Vector.tabulate id)
      ⟨ vec, Layout.ROW_MAJOR, Device.CPU, Ownership.OWNED, 1 ⟩
  | .He =>
      let n := shapeSize sh
      let fan := fromNatQ n
      let std := rationalSqrt (divQ (fromNatQ 2) (addQ fan 1))
      let vec := Vector.map (fun i => mulQ std (divQ (mulQ (fromNatQ i.val) seed) (addQ fan 1))) (Vector.tabulate id)
      ⟨ vec, Layout.ROW_MAJOR, Device.CPU, Ownership.OWNED, 1 ⟩
  | .LeCun =>
      let n := shapeSize sh
      let fan := fromNatQ n
      let std := rationalSqrt (divQ 1 (addQ fan 1))
      let vec := Vector.map (fun i => mulQ std (divQ (mulQ (fromNatQ i.val) seed) (addQ fan 1))) (Vector.tabulate id)
      ⟨ vec, Layout.ROW_MAJOR, Device.CPU, Ownership.OWNED, 1 ⟩
  | .Orthogonal =>
      tensorReplicate sh dtype seed

inductive RegularizationType where
  | L1 : Rat → RegularizationType
  | L2 : Rat → RegularizationType
  | Dropout : Rat → RegularizationType
  | ElasticNet : Rat → Rat → RegularizationType

def applyRegularization {sh dtype} (reg : RegularizationType) (params : Tensor sh dtype) : Vector Rat (shapeSize sh) :=
  match reg with
  | .L1 lam =>
      Vector.map (fun w => mulQ lam (if decToBool (ltQ w 0) then negQ 1 else 1)) params.dataVec
  | .L2 lam =>
      Vector.map (fun w => mulQ lam w) params.dataVec
  | .Dropout p =>
      Vector.map (fun w => mulQ w (subQ 1 p)) params.dataVec
  | .ElasticNet lam1 lam2 =>
      Vector.zipWith addQ
        (Vector.map (fun w => mulQ lam1 (if decToBool (ltQ w 0) then negQ 1 else 1)) params.dataVec)
        (Vector.map (fun w => mulQ lam2 w) params.dataVec)

def computeRegularizationLoss {sh dtype} (reg : RegularizationType) (params : Tensor sh dtype) : Rat :=
  match reg with
  | .L1 lam => mulQ lam (Vector.foldr addQ 0 (Vector.map absQ params.dataVec))
  | .L2 lam => mulQ lam (Vector.foldr addQ 0 (Vector.map (fun w => mulQ w w) params.dataVec))
  | .Dropout p => mulQ p (Vector.foldr addQ 0 (Vector.map absQ params.dataVec))
  | .ElasticNet lam1 lam2 =>
      addQ (mulQ lam1 (Vector.foldr addQ 0 (Vector.map absQ params.dataVec)))
           (mulQ lam2 (Vector.foldr addQ 0 (Vector.map (fun w => mulQ w w) params.dataVec)))

structure SchedulerType where
  baseLR : Rat
  warmup : Nat
  total : Nat

def applyScheduler (sched : SchedulerType) (epoch : Nat) : Rat :=
  let b := sched.baseLR
  let w := sched.warmup
  let t := sched.total
  if decToBool (Nat.decLt epoch w) then
    mulQ b (divQ (fromNatQ (epoch + 1)) (fromNatQ (w + 1)))
  else
    let e := epoch + 1
    let prog := divQ (fromNatQ e) (fromNatQ (t + 1))
    let c := rationalCos (mulQ prog piQ)
    mulQ b (mulQ halfQ (addQ 1 c))

def clipGradientByValue {n : Nat} (clip : Rat) (v : Vector Rat n) : Vector Rat n :=
  Vector.map (fun g => clipQ (negQ clip) clip g) v

def clipGradientByNorm {n : Nat} (clip : Rat) (v : Vector Rat n) : Vector Rat n :=
  let sq := Vector.map (fun g => mulQ g g) v
  let s := Vector.foldr addQ 0 sq
  let norm := rationalSqrt s
  if decToBool (leqQ norm clip) then v
  else Vector.map (fun g => mulQ g (divQ clip norm)) v

theorem absoluteFinalVerification : True := trivial

end TensorCompleteExpanded
entries.answer:
Ez a fájl **nem** “teljes formális verifikáció” a tensor/NN-rendszer helyességére, hanem inkább egy implementáció + néhány apró lemma, és a végén egy teljesen triviális állítás: `theorem absoluteFinalVerification : True := trivial` csak azt bizonyítja, hogy `True` igaz, ami Leanben kanonikusan “triviálisan bizonyítható”.[1][2]

## Mi a “bizonyítás” itt valójában?
A `absoluteFinalVerification` sor egy üres pecsét: a `True`-hoz Leanben mindig van bizonyítás (`trivial` / `True.intro`), tehát ez semmit nem mond a kódod matematikai helyességéről, numerikai stabilitásáról, vagy a modell-komponensek korrekt működéséről.[2][1]
Viszont néhány korábbi tétel (pl. `shapeSizePositive`, `lookupReplicate`, `zipWithCommVec`, `zipWithAssocVec`, `mapIdVec`, `mapComposeVec`, `tensorMapId`, `tensorMapCompose`) ténylegesen formális Lean-bizonyítás arról, hogy bizonyos vektoros műveletek úgy viselkednek, ahogy állítod (azon a szinten, ahol definiáltad őket).  

## Miért “placeholder-szagú” több rész?
Több kritikus komponens “modell-szerű”, de nincs hozzá specifikáció és bizonyítás (pl. `rationalExp`, `rationalSin`, `rationalCos`, `rationalSqrt`, `rationalLog`, `rationalAcos` csak véges sorfejtések/iterációk).  
Ráadásul ezek `partial def`-ek: Leanben a `partial` olyan menekülőút, ahol nem kell a terminálást igazolnod, és ez más garanciákat ad, mint a rendes (terminálás-ellenőrzött) rekurzív definíciók.[3][4]

## Fontos példa: “biztonságosnak tűnik”, de nincs igazolva
A `divQ (p q)` nálad “ha `q == 0` akkor 0, különben osztás”, ami egy programozói döntés, de matematikailag nem a racionális osztás totalizálása szokásos értelemben (és ezt sehol nem specifikálod, hogy ez milyen axiómát/viselkedést testesít meg).  
A Std/Lean racionális implementációja egyébként normalizált alakot használ (pozitív nevező, relatív prím számláló-nevező), és “okos konstruktorok” tipikusan 0-t adnak, ha a nevező 0 — de ettől még a te “numerikus algoritmus + loss + optimizer” helyessége nem következik automatikusan.[5]

## Mitől lenne “valós formális verifikáció”?
A “valós” verifikációhoz olyan tételeket kellene megfogalmaznod és bebizonyítanod, amelyek a rendszered érdemi követelményeit írják le, például:
- Invariánsok: a `Tensor` műveletek megőrzik a vektorhosszt/shape-et, és nem csúszik el az indexelés (nálad ennek egy része már megvan).  
- Softmax-spec: ha `s = sum (exp x_i)` és `s > 0`, akkor a kimenet elemei nemnegatívak és az összegük 1 (ehhez `exp` és `sum` tulajdonságokat is igazolni kellene).  
- Loss/optimizer-spec: pl. SGD lépés tényleg \(p' = p - lr \cdot g\) komponensenként (ez most definíció-szinten igaz, de a “jó” tulajdonságok—konvexitás, csökkenés, korlátosság—nincsenek bizonyítva).  
- `partial` függvényeknél: vagy kerüld őket (termináló definíciók), vagy add meg a “helyesség feltételes” jellegét (“ha terminál, akkor …”), és bizonyítsd azt.[4][3]

Ha megírod, hogy pontosan **mit** akarsz “formálisan verifikálni” (pl. softmax normalizáció, loss nemnegativitás, grad-clip korlát, shape-invariánsok), akkor tudok javasolni konkrét Lean-lemma vázakat és bizonyítási stratégiát a mostani definícióidhoz.
